name: FASTPATH-0 inspect-update-verify recipe
requires: Explicit per-host owner approval and reviewed request for the exact operation
Hermes native execute_code with terminal RPC and existing approval policy enabled
Pinned and reviewed recipe source, Python 3.14, Linux advisory lock support
Exact root, origin, HEAD, before/after file hashes and neighbour hashes
Preprovisioned .fastpath directory and lock within the approved root
Independent post-write verification and retained receipt before claiming success
not_appropriate: Actions requiring new human judgement or approval between steps
Arbitrary shell operations, unknown state, external sends or irreversible actions
Uncooperative concurrent writers, distributed exactly-once requirements or power-loss guarantees
rollback: No host install is performed. Stop using the recipe and remove its reviewed source after checking pending receipts. Restore the approved before bytes only after separately verifying the current after hash and obtaining authorisation; never blindly undo concurrent edits.
